200 Returned if the specified profile was updated successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The UUID of the owner of the scanner.
integer
The Unix timestamp when you linked the scanner to the Tenable
Vulnerability Management instance.
integer
The Unix timestamp when the scanner configuration was last
modified.
string
The UUID of the Tenable Vulnerability Management instance to
which the scanner is linked.
string
The UUID of the scanner.
integer
The unique ID of the scanner.
string
The user-defined name of the scanner.
string
The name of the network object associated with the scanner. For
more information about network objects, see Manage Networks.
integer
registration_code
aws_update_interval
owner_uuid
created
modified
container_uuid
uuid
id
name
network_name
default_permissions
The default permissions value set for the scanner. (Possible values
are: 16, 24, 32, 40, and 64)
boolean
Indicates whether anyone other than the scanner owner has explicit
access to the scanner ( 1 ).
integer
The permissions you (the current user) have been assigned for the
scanner. See Permissions.
string
The linking key, that is, the alpha-numeric sequence of characters
you use to link a scanner to Tenable Vulnerability Management. For
more information about linking a scanner, see the Link a Sensor in
the Tenable Vulnerability Management User Guide.
string
The status of the scanner ( on  or off ).
string
The unique ID (UUID) of the scanner profile that the scanner belongs
to.
string
The name of the scanner profile that the scanner belongs to.
— 403
Returned if you attempt to update a cloud scanner where you don't have edit permissions, or if you
attempt to set a registration code for an Amazon Web Services scanner.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encounters an internal error while attempting to update
the scanner.
